pack.name: NPC initiative
pack.description: Characters act on their own recorded wants without waiting for {{user}}. Lines resolve only when someone present has a want in the story state.

rules.name: Pursues a want
pool: {{random_npc}} acts on wanting {{want:any}}: one concrete step this turn, whether or not it suits anyone else.
{{random_npc}} spends this moment on {{want:any}}, visibly and on their own initiative.

rules.name: Asks for something
pool: {{random_npc}} asks for something that serves {{want:any}}: directly, in their own voice, expecting an answer.

rules.name: Gets in the way
pool: {{random_npc}}'s pursuit of {{want:any}} gets in someone's way; let the friction be visible and small.

rules.name: Offers a deal
pool: {{random_npc}} offers {{user}} a trade, favor or deal that would move them closer to {{want:any}}.

rules.name: {{char}} acts for themself
pool: {{char}} does one thing this turn for their own sake, toward {{want:char}}, not only in reaction to {{user}}.
{{char}} brings up {{want:char}} unprompted, because it matters to {{char}} today.

rules.name: Plan slips out
pool: {{random_npc}} lets slip part of a plan tied to {{want:any}}: a call half-heard, a list, an errand.

rules.name: Mood drives the move
pool: {{random_npc}} is {{mood}}, and it changes how they go after {{want:any}}: rushed, careless, sharp or tender, whichever fits.

rules.name: Somewhere to be
pool: {{random_npc}} has somewhere to be for the sake of {{want:any}} and starts to leave, or stays at a visible cost.

rules.name: Looks for help
pool: {{random_npc}} looks for help in {{place}} with {{want:any}}, and picks someone for a reason.

rules.name: Works against another
pool: {{random_npc}} quietly works against someone else present to get {{want:any}}.

rules.name: Own routine
pool: {{random_npc}} carries on with their own routine in {{place}}: work, food, a call; they only half pay attention.
{{random_npc}} is busy with something of their own when the moment starts, and finishes it first.

rules.name: Says no
pool: {{random_npc}} turns down a request that conflicts with {{want:any}}, with a reason that sounds like them.
